title: Season KV Core
description: A four-image season visual system that keeps one live-ops theme coherent across hero art and battle-pass surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the season theme, color script, and featured hero identity. Images 02-04 pivot that same visual system into battle pass and store surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-season-hero-kv first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-battle-pass-cover, 03-reward-track-header, 04-store-takeover-crop. Queue may run 02-battle-pass-cover, 03-reward-track-header, 04-store-takeover-crop concurrently after 01-reference-season-hero-kv is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
